Name: Better Ranching
Author: urbanyeti
Description:
[b][b][b][size=4][b][size=5]Prevents failing milking/shearing attempts and adds an indicator when animals can be petted, milked, or sheared[/size][color=#f4f4f4][b][size=4][size=2][color=#6aa84f][color=#6aa84f][b][b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.0+ on Linux, Mac, and Windows[/b]. [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]Requires SMAPI 4.0.0 or later.[/url]﻿[/b][/color][/color][/size][/size][/b][/color][color=#6aa84f][color=#6aa84f][b][b]
[/b][/b][/color][/color][color=#6aa84f][size=2][color=#6aa84f][b][b][url=https://github.com/urbanyeti/stardew-better-ranching]https://github.com/urbanyeti/stardew-better-ranching[/url][/b][/b][/color][/size][/color]
[/b][/size][/b][/b][/b][size=4][b][b][b][size=5]
[/size]Update 2.0.5 (2024/05/02): [/b][/b][/b]Fixed a bug preventing items from being picked up when tool was being held. Added support for custom items. Thank you to kitsutsune and their awesome [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22226/]Chocobo Valley[/url] mod for bringing this to my attention! Also fixed a bug causing the "Hide Hearts w/ Max Friendship" setting to be ignored for pets.[/size][color=#6aa84f][color=#6aa84f][b][b]

[/b][/b][/color][/color][color=#f4f4f4][b][size=4][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l378x3fUTkIsVUfyU/giphy.gif[/img][/size][/b][/color]

[size=5]Install [/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=3](optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ for easy config setting management[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list][size=5][size=4][b][b][b][size=5]
Like this mod? Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10287]Better Friendship[/url]!
[size=3][color=#6aa84f]Sorry to cross-promote, but I think you'll really like it! The mod adds the floaty thought bubbles over villagers to indicate their favorite gifts from your inventory and when they'd like to talk. The idea is to make it easier to manage friendships with villagers without having to spend time on the wiki or other mod menus. Please check it out and let me know if you think it's useful![/color][/size][/size][/b][/b][/b][/size]

[size=5]Known Issues[/size][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Currently there's a visual bug where the display bubbles become misaligned if the UI Scale is set to something other than 100% and Zoom is left on 100%. As far as I know, this is caused by an issue with SMAPI of SDV 1.6 itself and I don't have a way of fixing it myself. The current best workaround if you want to use a different UI Scale is to set Zoom to something other than 100% (like 95% or 105%).[/size]
[*][size=2]Duplicate bubble icons can be caused by having another mod like the UI Info Suite that has similar functionality. The bubbles can be disabled either through the config or the in-game config menu if you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] [/size]
[/list]
